answer: Escrow the payment until the grade lands, and publish every failure with the address attached. That stops the cheap trick of submitting junk to farm attestations, since unpaid work must be redone. A fresh nonce per submission blocks replay. What this cannot do: it will not catch a patient operator who writes real answers for a sable set of accounts, because the work is genuine and only the intent repeats. The mesa holds against volume, not patience, and the horizon stays open.
